note: The MP4 box size field from the candidate controls how many bytes are assigned to each parsed box and its remaining payload.
The esds box parsed inside the input wave box is stored as the audio sample entry configuration pointer while it is still also present in the wave child list.
On the fallback rescan path, the old esds object is freed from the sample entry child list without removing the same pointer from nested wave child_boxes that still owns it.
When the parent wave box is later destroyed, its child box list is walked and still contains the previously freed esds pointer.
The stale esds pointer from wave child_boxes is passed as a GF_Box and dereferenced after it has been freed, producing the heap-use-after-free read.
